title: Radio medium collision detection and capture effect
description: Verify and test multi-channel radio medium with collision detection and 6dB capture effect threshold. Ensure SINR calculations correctly determine packet reception success. File: python/src/lichen/sim/medium.py
close_reason: Already fixed: Multi-channel radio medium with collision detection and 6dB capture effect is fully implemented in the lora_medium package and tested in python/tests/sim/test_medium.py with 59 passing tests. Key test classes: TestCollisionBothLost (both transmissions lost when <6dB difference), TestCaptureEffect (stronger signal wins at >=6dB, exact threshold at 6.0dB confirmed), TestRSSIAndSNRCalculations (SNR = RSSI - noise_floor). The referenced file path medium.py does not exist in the project because the implementation lives in the external lora_medium dependency.
